name: Souls
overview: Scripture reveals that the soul is the essential life given by God, as seen in Genesis 2:7 where man became a living soul through God's breath. Souls belong to God and are accountable to Him, with sin bringing death to the soul (Ezekiel 18:4, 18:20). While the body can be killed by others, only God can destroy both body and soul in hell (Matthew 10:28). The New Testament affirms the value of saving souls, as many were added to the faith and baptized, illustrating the spiritual transformation and salvation of the soul (Acts 2:41).
